closureStatement: Refrigerator family architecture is closed. CG-7 discovery, CG-8 french-door compounding, CG-9 SxS configuration boundary, and CG-9.5 SxS production compounding demonstrate that one frozen functional contract absorbs manufacturer and configuration variation with zero canonical expansion. Additional refrigerator manuals are coverage work, not architecture validation.
